title: HarmonyHub - Music School Web Platform
description: This project is a full-stack web application developed for a local music school, offering an elegant and modern online presence. Built with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), the platform provides students, parents, and instructors with a smooth and interactive experience.
features: Courses & Scheduling: Browse available music courses (instrumental, vocal, theory) and book lessons directly through the platform.
Photo Gallery: A visual collection of classes, events, student recitals, and behind-the-scenes moments from the school.
Teacher Profiles: Meet the team of experienced instructors with detailed bios, expertise, and contact options.
Student Dashboard: Personalized portal for students to manage schedules, track progress, and view upcoming lessons or events.
Admin Panel: Full backend control over courses, student accounts, and content updates through a secure interface.
Secure Authentication: Account creation and login features for both students and staff with protected routes and session management.

title: CovorFix - Carpet Repair & Sales Platform
description: This project is a web platform for a local business based in Reghin, Romania, specializing in carpet and rug repair services, as well as the sale of new carpets and rugs. Built with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), the platform offers a modern and user-friendly experience for customers.
features: Interactive Catalog: Browse through a dynamic collection of available carpets and rugs with detailed product descriptions and high-quality images.
Repair Service Scheduling: Customers can easily request pickup and schedule repair services online.
Admin Dashboard: Manage orders, service requests, and product listings from a secure backend panel.
Authentication & Security: User accounts with secure login and order tracking capabilities.

title: Next.js Discord Clone
description: This project is a modern Discord clone built with Next.js, Prisma, and MySQL. It features real-time chat, audio/video channels, and server management — all styled with Tailwind CSS for a responsive and sleek user interface.
features: Real-time Chat: Instantly send and receive messages using WebSockets with support for text and media channels.
Server & Channel Management: Create servers, organize channels, and manage members with ease.
Audio/Video Rooms: Join voice or video calls via integrated WebRTC-based media rooms.
Secure Authentication: Seamless login experience powered by Clerk and session-protected routes.

title: MERN Real-Time Chat App
description: This application enables users to communicate in real-time with a sleek and modern interface. It supports user registration, login, and real-time messaging powered by Socket.io. Users can also send images directly through the clipboard or upload them manually, which are then stored securely on Cloudinary.
features: Real-Time Messaging: Chat with others instantly using Socket.io for a fast and dynamic experience.
User Authentication: Register and login securely using JWT-based authentication.
Image Sharing: Send images directly from your clipboard or upload files, with automatic Cloudinary integration.
Responsive UI: Designed with DaisyUI to ensure a seamless experience across all devices.
32 different Themes: Support 32 different themes.

title: MERN Product Management App
description: This app allows to manage products in a seamless way, providing an easy-to-use interface to add, update, and delete products. It includes two themes for better customization: Dark and Light modes. Chakra UI is used for a smooth and responsive user experience.
features: Dark and Light Themes: Switch between dark and light themes with ease to fit your preference.
CRUD Product Management: Admins can efficiently add, update, or delete products stored in a MongoDB database.
Responsive UI: Chakra UI ensures a smooth user interface, optimized for both desktop and mobile devices.

title: FullStack JavaScript Pet Adoption App
description: This project comes in two versions, demonstrating different full-stack approaches:
features: Version 1 (Vanilla JS & CSS - Netlify): A lightweight implementation using plain JavaScript and CSS. Backend logic runs through Netlify Functions.
Version 2 (React & Next.js - Render and Vercel): A full-stack version using React and Next.js deployed on Render and Vercel.
CRUD Pet Management: Admins can manage pet listings stored in MongoDB Cloud.
Cloudinary Integration: Pet photos are uploaded and served efficiently via Cloudinary.
Live Admin Chat (Render Version): A real-time internal chat between admins, built with Pusher and integrated into the React & Next.js frontend.
Responsive UI: Optimized for both desktop and mobile.

title: FullStack Responsive ASP.NET + Angular Social Media Platform
description: This platform is a fully functional dating app, built with a solid tech stack. The backend uses ASP.NET for reliable performance, while the frontend is developed with Angular to ensure a smooth and responsive user experience.
Overall, the platform is designed to make it easy for users to connect, chat, and share images while enjoying a clean and engaging interface.
features: Photo Upload: Users can easily upload and manage their photos via Cloudinary, providing fast and secure media handling.
Real-Time Messaging: With SignalR, users can send live messages and see who's online, creating a more interactive experience.
Responsive Design: The app uses TailwindCSS 4 for a clean and modern look, making it user-friendly across devices.
Theme Support: Users can switch between light and dark modes, and the app automatically adjusts based on their system settings.

title: Fullstack WoW Registration & Donation System
features: Built with ASP.NET for the backend and Angular for the frontend.
Allows users to register and manage their World of Warcraft accounts.
Secure payment integration for donations.
Modern and responsive UI for a smooth user experience.
Admin panel for managing users and transactions.

title: Figma to HTML — Pixel Perfect Implementation
Figma to HTML — Pixel Perfect Implementation
VS Code Extension — PHP Tag Background Highlighter
features: Enhances the visibility of PHP code inside HTML files.
Changes the background color of PHP tags for better readability.
Customizable themes to match your preferred coding style.
Lightweight and optimized for smooth performance.
Perfect for developers working with mixed HTML and PHP files.

title: Personal To-Do App in Python
features: Designed to fit my personal workflow and productivity needs.
Simple, fast, and lightweight — no unnecessary features.
Built with Python for flexibility and customization.
Helps me organize tasks efficiently in a way that suits me best.
A personal project that improves my daily productivity.

title: Python REST API Communications Network
description: World of Warcraft & Discord AI Chat Integration
features: Developed a Python script that links in-game chat from two different World of Warcraft clients through a server.
Integrated ChatGPT to allow AI-powered responses to player messages directly in the game.
Implemented a cross-version world chat, enabling players from different WoW versions to communicate.
Connected the entire system to a Discord channel for real-time updates and chat synchronization.
Utilized multiple REST APIs to manage communication between game clients, the server, AI, and Discord.
Ensured seamless interaction between players, AI, and different platforms through this advanced chat system.

title: Unity Advanced AI — Zombie System
features: Developed an advanced AI system for a zombie creature in Unity.
The AI can behave as a friend or an enemy, dynamically adapting to the situation.
Implemented multiple states: Idle, Patrol, Alert, Chase, and more.
The zombie reacts to environmental factors like smell, sound, and light.
Designed to track and chase players based on their actions and surroundings.
Realistic AI behavior.

title: AI Bot for World of Warcraft (MaNGOS)
features: Developed an advanced AI bot for World of Warcraft using the MaNGOS server.
The bot can patrol cities, automatically grind for experience, and interact with NPCs.
Conversations are powered by ChatGPT, making the bot capable of dynamic dialogues.
NPCs also respond using AI, creating a more immersive experience.
Fully automated gameplay with decision-making based on real-time events.
